# T3 Code source provenance

Ticketry's structured Chat-run implementation adapts portions of T3 Code under
the accompanying MIT license.

- Upstream repository: <https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code>
- Audited revision: `45d9aa90baab8f2d6b13c7ae3cf2f97128edaf7b`
- Revision date: 2026-08-07
- Upstream copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 T3 Tools Inc.

Each substantially copied or translated source file should also name its
upstream path and revision in its file header. The integration map is recorded
in
`spec/agents-sdk--173b3d9e/T62--i-wanna-build-a-chat-interface-for-the-c/T3_TRANSPLANT_PLAN.md`.

The desktop web bundle carries the same notice at
`studio/public/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt`, so the attribution ships with release
artifacts rather than existing only in the source tree.
